facts.en: Completed a diploma in Construction Administration at Fictional Institute D038 in 2024.
facts.zh: 2024 年在虚构院校 D038 完成施工行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a project office assistant at Fictional Builder D038 from 2024-08 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-08 至 2026-08 在虚构建筑企业 D038 担任项目办公室助理。

facts.en: Maintained drawing-transmittal and request-for-information logs on one office-refurbishment project.
facts.zh: 在一个办公室翻新项目维护图纸传递及信息请求记录。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet filters and document revision codes to route current drawings to approved recipients.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选及文件修订编码，将最新版图纸发送给获批接收者。

facts.en: With the site administrator, reconciled 86 transmittals against receipt acknowledgments during 2026-02.
facts.zh: 在 2026-02 与现场行政员合作，依据签收确认核对 86 份文件传递记录。

facts.en: That review identified 13 missing acknowledgments; 10 were obtained within the month and 3 remained escalated to the site administrator.
facts.zh: 该复查发现 13 份缺失签收确认；月内取得 10 份，其余 3 份仍由现场行政员跟进。

facts.en: Recorded meeting minutes and action owners; the project manager approved minutes before circulation.
facts.zh: 记录会议纪要及行动负责人；项目经理在分发前审批纪要。

facts.en: Entered subcontractor attendance from signed sheets without certifying work quality or approving invoices.
facts.zh: 根据签字表录入分包商出勤，不认证施工质量或审批发票。

facts.en: Drafted an induction-pack index in 2026-04; the safety officer had not approved it for operational use.
facts.zh: 2026-04 起草入场培训资料索引；安全专员尚未批准其投入实际使用。

facts.en: Weekend volunteer at Fictional Repair Club V038 from 2025-03 to 2025-11 while employed; kept tool sign-out records only.
facts.zh: 2025-03 至 2025-11 任职期间，周末在虚构维修社团 V038 做志愿工作；仅维护工具借出记录。

facts.en: Made a personal cardboard model of a community hall as a hobby; it was not an engineered or permitted design.
facts.zh: 出于爱好制作社区礼堂纸板模型；该模型并非工程设计或获许可设计。

facts.en: At the project peak in 2025-10, maintained logs for 7 subcontractor packages; by 2026-08 only 2 packages remained active.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 项目高峰期维护 7 个分包工作包记录；到 2026-08 仅有 2 个仍在进行。

facts.en: An unsigned reference draft describes project value as 8 million currency units, while an internal briefing says 6 million; neither value is verified.
facts.zh: 一份未签字推荐草稿将项目金额记为 8 百万货币单位，内部简报则记为 6 百万；两者均未经核实。

facts.en: Used PDF markup to flag missing drawing numbers for review; did not alter technical design content.
facts.zh: 使用 PDF 批注标出缺失图号供审查；未修改技术设计内容。

facts.en: No quantity-surveying qualification, site-safety certification or budget ownership is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录工料测量资格、工地安全认证或预算负责经历。

facts.en: The appointment was administrative and office-based; site visits occurred only with an authorized escort.
facts.zh: 该岗位属于办公室行政工作；现场访问仅在授权人员陪同下进行。
